MSFT.rationale: MSFT presents a strong fundamental case: 18.3% YoY revenue growth, 23.4% EPS growth, 46.3% operating margin, and 26% OCF growth in Q3 FY2026, with a fortress balance sheet (net cash ~$38B, D/E 0.119). The franchise is best-in-class — Azure at 40% growth, $37B AI run rate, $392B commercial RPO. However, the score is tempered by: (1) gross margin compression to 67.6% (lowest since 2022) from 68.7% driven by AI capex intensity ($190B 2026 capex plan), even as operating margin expanded; (2) FCF compression to $15.8B from $20.3B despite OCF growth, reflecting the capital intensity; (3) Copilot at only 4.4% M365 penetration with declining AI subscriber market share (18.8% to 11.5%); and (4) regulatory headwinds (FTC antitrust probe, EU Cloud Act). Valuation at 30.5x trailing P/E (~30th percentile of 1-year range) is attractive vs own history and partially reflects these concerns, but the rate environment (10Y at 4.47%) limits multiple expansion potential. The NVIDIA partnership (RTX Spark, 2026-06-01) and in-house AI model progress (Build conference, 2026-06-03) provide modest near-term catalysts but are not transformative re-rating events. Net: a high-quality franchise at a reasonable but not deeply discounted valuation, with genuine capex/margin uncertainty that caps the score below +0.5.
